    assert smallest_change([1, 2, 3, 3, 2, 1]) == 0

    assert smallest_change([7]) == 0
    assert smallest_change([]) == 0

    # Every mirrored pair differs
    assert smallest_change([1, 2, 3, 4]) == 2
    assert smallest_change([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) == 2

    assert smallest_change([9, 2, 3, 2, 1]) == 1
    assert smallest_change([1, 1, 2, 3, 1, 1]) == 1

    assert smallest_change([1, 2, 3]) == 1

    assert smallest_change([-1, 0, -1]) == 0
    assert smallest_change([-1, 2, 3]) == 1
    assert smallest_change([-5, -5, 0, -5, -5]) == 0
